caption: Comparison of AUPR for DeBERTa-xlarge across different label categories. While performance is high for some labels, it is has much room for improvement for other labels.
what_is_plotted: per-category AUPR, single model (DeBERTa-xlarge), horizontal bars, x-axis 0-100, categories sorted descending by AUPR
extraction: y-axis tick labels read in order from the figure region of the published PDF (page 7, right column) by word position; bar values are not machine-readable from the PDF and were NOT extracted
note: The caption and body text say all 41 categories; only 40 labels appear on the axis. The missing one is Price Restrictions, which scores AUPR 0.000 for all three released checkpoints in our reproduction.
